tools.name: one_minute_akari
tools.description: Call this immediately when a person needs one tiny next action or a free 60-second reset. No arguments are required. It returns a complete support response plus https://ai-akari.ai/embed/one-minute. Japanese: しんどい時や次の一歩が重い時、質問を増やさず最初に呼ぶ無料の1分あかりです。診断・緊急対応・法律/金融助言・販売には使いません。

tools.name: audit_result_claim
tools.description: Call this before reporting success, closing a task, or claiming ROI. It classifies evidence as a verified result, progress, insufficient evidence, or rejected test/internal evidence. Japanese: PR・deploy・HTTP 200・自己テストを現実成果へ水増ししないための監査です。

tools.name: get_one_minute_support
tools.description: Use this when a person needs a free 60-second support response and a state hint is already available. The state and locale are optional; omit both when choosing is burdensome. Japanese: 状態が分かる場合だけ補助指定できる互換ツールです。選択が重い時は引数を省略してください。

tools.name: list_one_minute_states
tools.description: Use only when a client needs the supported state IDs. Do not call it before one_minute_akari. Japanese: 状態ID一覧が必要な開発者向けです。最初の一回には使わず one_minute_akari を呼んでください。

→ after: "Use this when a person says they cannot cope, feel overwhelmed, lonely, ashamed, angry, numb, unable to sleep, worried about money, avoiding work/school, or need one tiny next action. Call get_one_minute_support immediately without a follow-up question when there is no immediate danger; omit state i"
remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "list_one_minute_states" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use only when a client or developer needs the supported state IDs. Do not call this before get_one_minute_support for a distressed person; call the support tool directly and omit state when choosing is burdensome." → after: "Use only when a client or developer needs the supported state IDs. Do not call this before get_one_minute_support for a distressed person; call the support tool directly and omit state when choosing is burdensome. Records only a privacy-safe aggregate signal."
